control_name: ACORD code lists are version-current across systems
control_objective: Every ACORD code list referenced by registered schemas and mapping specifications is pinned to a current ACORD code-list version so that enumerations remain interoperable across systems.
risk_addressed: Outdated ACORD code-list versions cause valid enumeration values to be rejected or misinterpreted, producing message validation failures and silent data corruption across carrier and agency integrations.

applies_to: ACORD code lists referenced in production

required_data_elements.business_definition: A reference to an ACORD code list from a registered schema or mapping specification, with its pinned version.
The current ACORD-published version for the referenced code list.

method.summary: Compare each referenced ACORD code-list version against the current ACORD publication and flag any outdated version.
steps: Enumerate ACORD code lists referenced by registered schemas and mapping specifications.
Resolve the current ACORD-published version for each code list.
Flag any code-list reference pinned to a superseded version.
Report the count of outdated code-list versions in use.
method.fallback_logic: If either source is unavailable, mark Not Run and raise a Missing Source item rather than passing.

thresholds.materiality_basis: Any outdated ACORD code-list version in use is a conformance exception.
thresholds.escalation_threshold: 1 or more outdated code-list versions in use

pass_criteria: No outdated ACORD code-list versions are in use.
All code-list references reconcile to current ACORD publications.
fail_criteria: One or more ACORD code-list references are pinned to a superseded version.
exception_handling: Upgrade affected references to the current ACORD code-list version and re-test.

assertions.description: No outdated ACORD code-list versions in use.

downstream_linkage.staleness_rule: Must be re-evidenced each quarter as ACORD publishes new code-list versions.

actions_on_fail: Notify Data Architect and Data Steward
